---
name: Run feedback
about: You ran the pipeline — tell us what it got right, wrong, or weird
title: "[Run] "
labels: run-feedback
---

**What you ran**
Mode (batch discovery / score-my-idea), field or field pack, and the
idea or research area, in one or two lines.

**What the pipeline produced**
The verdict or outcome (e.g. advanced, knocked out at the novelty gate,
net EV and rank) — and whether you agreed with it.

**Where it earned or lost your trust**
Specific moments: a claim the Verifier got right or wrong, a Critic
objection that was decisive or unfair, arithmetic you checked. Quotes
from the run records are gold here.

**What would have made the run more useful**
Missing output, unclear instructions, a gate that fired at the wrong
time — anything.

**Can we see the records?**
If you can share the run folder or blackboard record, attach it or say
so and we'll arrange it. If not, the summary above is still valuable.
